McpServerDefinition.description: Roadster Rentals fleet tools. Finds available rental cars by pickup location, category, and daily budget, and renders the results as the Roadster Rentals Fleet widget.

resources.description: Available Roadster Rentals cars with a featured hero car and Book buttons.

tools.descriptionOverride: Returns the available Roadster Rentals cars: a featured flagship car plus a list of other cars with daily price, seats, transmission, fuel, range, and rating. Use when a user wants to book, rent, reserve, or browse rental cars. All inputs are optional: location (Hyderabad Airport, Bengaluru Airport, San Francisco Airport, or a city name), category (Flagship, Electric, SUV, Sedan, Luxury, Sport, Economy), maxDailyRate in USD.
